reportedUse.exactCommitReadbackHelper: Used for the first three completed sources reported in the handoff
reportedUse.publicValidator: Reported exact public verification of 17 batches and 1259 jobs

knownLimitations: This snapshot preserves the frozen sources after the author corrected UTC parsing; it is not a full correctness certification.
Both helpers write local state or reports when invoked; SQL in the readback helper is SELECT-only, and the Python public validator performs no network access.
The readback helper still requires the original process actual exit_code=0; the pending state branch does not waive that gate.
excludedCategories: real database/context/public JSON and raw/evidence bodies
publisher state, completion summaries and internal logs
credentials, environment files and private profiles
dependencies, generated builds and registered runtime identity artifacts
recoveryLimits: Requires separately authorized current host helper/session state and exact review/evidence inputs.
Historical absolute paths and source/candidate identifiers remain original source bindings and require review before reuse.
External files have no original Git commit and must not be presented as the registered producer runtime.
Backup contains no active workflows; no CI, default update, merge or deployment.
changeDuringBackupReview: A negative-offset timestamp normalization flaw was identified before upload. The author changed only utc(): naive datetimes receive UTC, aware datetimes use astimezone(UTC). The earlier file was not uploaded.
